crossRefs.note: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit…
I find then the law that, to me, while I desire to do good, evil is present.
I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s…
For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.
For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that…
But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and…
Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good…
You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole…
Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from…
I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to…
For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.
Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good…
in gentleness correcting those who oppose him: perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the…
and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to his will.

translations.web: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
translations.bsb: But I see another law at work in my body, warring against the law of my mind and holding me captive to the law of sin that dwells within me.
